title: world-heavyweight-ewwf-alliance-1999
label: Guru

won.source: Recorded from the promotion's own billing, which frames Guru as the reigning World Heavyweight Champion entering his 9 February title defense.

note: His title triangle match against Kenneth Morlock and X-treme was interrupted by an outside theft of the belt before any fall; no clean successor is recorded from the documents read for this record.

title: united-states-ewwf-alliance-1999
label: Kenneth Morlock

won.source: Recorded from the promotion's own billing, which frames Kenneth Morlock as the reigning United States Champion entering his 24 January title defense.

note: Retained the title in a ladder match against Mark Spencer, saved from defeat by a returning ally's brass-knuckle interference; the last state of the title attested in the documents read for this record.

title: ironman-ewwf-alliance-1999
label: "Hellkid" Johnny Lords

won.source: Recorded from the promotion's own billing, which frames Johnny Lords as the reigning Ironman Champion entering his 24 January title defense.

note: Retained the title against the Great Southern Rapist on 24 January and against Simon Solkoff in a Taipei Fist submission match on 9 February; the last state of the title attested in the documents read for this record.

title: extreme-ewwf-alliance-1999
label: Harvester of Sorrow

won.source: Won the Extreme Championship from Farley Lane in a two-out-of-three-falls scaffold and steel cage match, two falls to one, the second by a top-rope Sandblaster through the broadcast's own announce table.

note: The last state of the title attested in the documents read for this record.

title: extreme-ewwf-alliance-1999
label: Farley Lane

won.source: Recorded from the promotion's own billing, which frames Farley Lane as the reigning Extreme Champion entering his 9 February title defense.

note: Lost the title to Harvester of Sorrow in a two-out-of-three-falls scaffold and steel cage match, two falls to one.

title: internet-ewwf-alliance-1999
label: Preacher

won.source: Won the Internet Championship from Luni in a barbed-wire-bat gimmick match after interference from his own manager, Tony T.

note: Retained the title against Higor Rosa on 9 February in a fire-and-weapons brawl before losing it to the Great Southern Rapist on 15 February by a surprise rollup.

title: internet-ewwf-alliance-1999
label: Great Southern Rapist

won.source: Won the Internet Championship from Preacher by a surprise rollup after a bloody chair-and-table brawl.

note: The last state of the title attested in the documents read for this record.

title: internet-ewwf-alliance-1999
label: Luni

won.source: Recorded from the promotion's own billing, which frames Luni as the reigning Internet Champion entering his 24 January title defense.

note: Lost the title to Preacher in a barbed-wire-bat gimmick match after interference from Preacher's manager, Tony T.

title: world-tag-team-ewwf-alliance-1999
label: Family of Thugz

won.source: Recorded from the promotion's own billing, which frames the Family of Thugz (Chris Rollins and Scorpio) as the reigning World Tag Team Champions entering their 24 January title defense.

note: Retained the titles against Farley Lane and Higor Rosa on 24 January and against the Great Southern Rapist and Immortal Doomsday on 9 February, the latter challengers written out of the match by an in-storyline arrest; the last state of the titles attested in the documents read for this record.
